arguments.summary: Commodities channel: supplied evidence supports no independent commodity-price directional signal over the 63-session horizon. MU’s product-memory pricing/mix is an issuer operating driver, not a quoted commodity input; NVDA’s customer data-center power/capacity is an indirect infrastructure constraint. Input-cost pass-through, hedging and commodity sensitivity are unquantified.

claims.text: MU reported finished goods, work in process, and raw-materials-and-supplies inventories as of May 28, 2026, but these balance-sheet amounts do not identify raw-material contract pricing, hedges, or sensitivity to energy/metals costs.

NVDA disclosed raw-material inventory and inventory provisions, while separately identifying supply dependence on overseas partners, especially Taiwan and South Korea. The supplied excerpts do not quantify a commodity-input cost exposure.

NVDA disclosed land, power and shell guarantees for select AI-cloud partners. This establishes customer-infrastructure capacity as a potential indirect demand/credit channel, not an observed electricity-price exposure or a direct commodity cost sensitivity.

For MU, the nearer operating channel is product-memory demand/pricing and mix: its Q4 guidance explicitly embeds revenue, gross-margin and EPS assumptions. A weaker product-pricing/demand or margin outcome would weaken the elevated-profitability assumptions; an offset could be the disclosed strategic customer agreements and AI-memory product ramp. Neither establishes any oil, power, metals, or materials beta.

For NVDA, customer ability to complete AI-data-center builds is a plausible indirect constraint on hardware demand; the disclosed guarantees make the infrastructure linkage concrete. The competing offset is that the reported Q3 outlook assumes $108 billion revenue and no China Data Center compute revenue, so this disclosure alone does not show a near-term capacity shortfall. Commodity direction remains unmeasured.
QQQ’s dated equity holdings included NVDA at 8.535228% and MU at 5.012336% as of September 18, 2026. These establish issuer overlap only; they do not establish QQQ commodity beta.

gaps.description: No supplied disclosure quantifies either issuer’s energy/metals/material input-cost share, purchase-contract indexation, hedging, pass-through, or margin sensitivity. This blocks an independent commodity-cost conclusion, but not issuer product-pricing or other-role business conclusions.

No supplied evidence measures customer power availability, power-price changes, or data-center completion delays; NVDA’s guarantees establish a possible channel but not magnitude or direction over the horizon.
QQQ holdings identify issuer overlap, but the supplied fund materials contain no commodity exposure or beta measure.

assumptions: Product-memory pricing refers to MU’s semiconductor product economics, not a quoted commodity series.
No independent commodity stance is taken absent quantified issuer exposure or an observed customer-capacity disruption.
arguments.counter_thesis: An unobserved energy, materials, or power shock could become material quickly if either issuer has unhedged concentrated inputs or if customer power constraints defer deployments; the provided documents cannot size that possibility.

review_conditions.description: Revisit if an NVDA filing/results release quantifies power/land capacity delays, guarantee losses, or supplier/input-cost effects on revenue or gross margin; a quantified adverse effect would weaken demand/margin assumptions, while demonstrated capacity completion without such costs would weaken this constraint thesis.

Revisit if MU reports memory ASP/demand or gross-margin guidance materially below its stated Q4 framework, or quantifies materials/energy costs or supply commitments; adverse pricing/cost disclosure would weaken the FY2026 completion assumptions, while sustained pricing/margin would strengthen them.

shared_exposures.mechanism: QQQ has dated holdings in both issuers, so issuer-specific semiconductor product-demand or supply/infrastructure developments can transmit to the fund; holdings establish overlap, not commodity beta.
shared_exposures.qualification: Weights are dated September 18, 2026 sponsor holdings and are not current holdings or personalized portfolio exposure.
